fields.label: Iso Country Code
fields.help: Two-character code, in ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 format, for the country or region of the pool.

fields.label: Opt Out List Name
fields.help: Name of the opt-out list to associate with the pool.

fields.label: Origination Identities
fields.help: Set of origination identity ARNs to associate with the pool.

fields.label: Region
fields.help: Region where this resource will be [managed](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/general/latest/gr/rande.html#regional-endpoints).

fields.label: Self Managed Opt Outs Enabled
fields.help: Whether the pool relies on self-managed opt-out handling.

fields.label: Shared Routes Enabled
fields.help: Whether shared routes are enabled for the pool.

fields.label: Two Way Channel Arn
fields.help: ARN of the two-way channel that receives inbound messages.

fields.label: Two Way Channel Role
fields.help: ARN of the IAM role that End User Messaging SMS assumes to publish inbound messages to the two-way channel.

fields.label: Two Way Enabled
fields.help: Whether inbound message reception is enabled for the pool.
